name: 파워업덱 BOX 「TAG TEAM GX」
englishName: Tag Team GX Power Up Deck Box

description.text: The Sun & Moon Power-Up Deck Box TAG TEAM GX, released in Korean on 4 June 2019: ten packs of Double Blaze, a 60-card deck with one holo card, 44 more cards (one Pokémon, 37 Trainers and six Special Energy), a one-player playmat, a rule book, a Pokémon coin, a GX marker and a card box.

tell.text: An "SMN" mark at the bottom left, and a number out of 043
